_note: Copy to ~/.claude/token-usage/prices.json. Prices are per `per` tokens (default 1000000), in USD, from your provider's own pricing page; nothing here is a real price. A model with no input or output rate is counted in tokens but left unpriced. cached and cacheWrite default to the input rate, thinking to the output rate. longPrompt: rates for calls whose prompt (input + cached + cacheWrite) is above `above` tokens, for the whole call.
